messages.outlook.connection.auth-help: Use a delegated Microsoft Graph token with Mail.Read. Outlook, OneDrive, Teams and SharePoint can share the Graph token if it has the scopes for each service.
messages.outlook.guide.cli-note: Use Connect-MgGraph to sign in and call Graph. Molis Work does not read the PowerShell session.
messages.outlook.guide.mcp-note: A tenant administrator must enable the Work IQ preview, a Copilot license and Entra app permissions.
messages.outlook.guide.token-note: Use Graph Explorer to get a user token for testing. Register your own app for ongoing use.
messages.outlook.oauth.tenant: Tenant ID (leave blank for personal accounts or multitenant apps)
messages.outlook.setup.get-a-token-in-graph-explo: Get a token in Graph Explorer
